title: Permitted Installation Jobs and Billable Storage Days
content:
A permitted installation job shortens the billable storage of its order. For Factory Production Orders, a permit wait allowance comes off the billable storage days by the installation job's permit and its planned crew days:

| Installation job | Calendar days taken off the billable days |
|---|---|
| permitted, with 3 or more crew days planned | 10 |
| permitted, with fewer than 3 crew days planned | 5 |
| not permitted | none |

Billable days never fall below zero.

## Records read

From the Installation Jobs record of the order's installation job: whether the job is permitted and inspected, and the crew days booked for it.

## Edges (hypothetical jobs)

| Permitted | Crew days planned | Days taken off |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 3 | 10 |
| yes | 2 | 5 |
| yes | 1 | 5 |
| no | 4 | none |

## Hypothetical example

An order with 12 billable days whose installation job is permitted with 2 crew days planned has 5 days taken off, leaving 7 billable days.
